title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE BIG SCREEN PROMPTS
why: The card was stamped v19.46 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the 4K prompts and bars (v19.54, v19.55, v19.57, v19.61) and the co-op HUD placement (v19.47, v19.48, v19.58).
now: The what is new card names the big screen prompts.
